BREADCRUMB_TEXT Docs / Retries

Configuring retries

The client retries failed requests automatically, using exponential backoff with jitter, so that transient network errors do not surface to your application.

Basic usage

Pass a retry policy when you construct the client, and every request made through that client will follow it.

client = Client(retries=3)
client.get("/status")

Options

  • retries: the maximum number of attempts, including the first one.
  • backoff: the base delay in seconds between attempts.
OptionDefault
retries3
backoff0.5

Retries are never attempted for requests that are not idempotent unless you opt in explicitly, because repeating them could duplicate side effects on the server.
